platform: Windows x64, Abaqus 2025 HF1, Python 3.10.5 / NumPy 1.22.4
method: Five fresh processes per format per selection, sequential alternating order, current ASCII and binary writers. Same ODB bytes, instances, frames and PVD; bundled fixtures also export history. Imports/SDK startup and detailed instrumentation excluded from 50 primary timings. No cold-cache or fsync guarantee. Separate saved baseline package used to verify current ASCII output unchanged.
implementation: Optional uncompressed appended-raw VTU. Explicit little-endian Float64 points, Float32 fields and Int64 topology with UInt64 byte-count prefixes and offsets. Shape/layout metadata emitted before lazy field payloads, row chunks targeting 1 MiB, binary atomic publication. ASCII stays default; --format binary and vtu_format=binary supported in serial and parallel workers.
validation: All thirteen VTK pairs passed without warning/error events. Geometry/topology, numeric types, array metadata and auxiliary files match. Float32 tolerance at most one ULP: only 544 Material_Orientation components in Job-1 differ, all exact binary midpoints whose short decimal tokens round differently. Binary orientation matches direct Float32 conversion of original native-source float64 arrays exactly. Current ASCII sets match saved baseline byte-for-byte for all selections; input hashes unchanged.
